query: What do Apple iPhone SE buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: Locked. This phone was described as unlocked and can be used with any carrier. This phone was a locked phone. Buyer beware

Buyer beware. This phone never worked properly. We bought a new SIM card, had our carrier work with us a number of times, reset it, did a factory reset, had Apple look at every aspect of the hardware, changed carriers, still didn’t work. We ended up buying a new phone from the new carrier. Buyer beware.

Dishonest, unprofessional seller. Dishonest, unprofessional seller. Product description states that it is unlocked and compatible with any carrier including Sprint. This is not the case. Very disappointing. Seller was very unprofessional and unhelpful in interactions on the Amazon marketplace to try to resolve this.

Buyer Beware 1. I purchased the iPhone SE, and the phone is locked! You won't be able to use your sim card. I emailed their customer support and received no response. I went up to my carrier to see if anything could be done about it, and they could not help. Please be cautious when buying from this business.

PHONE WAS LATE AND NOT UNLOCKED :(. Phones was advertised as Carrier Unlocked or at the very least compatible with the major service provider that I use and the phone was advertised to work for. This was not the case, not only did the phone show up late but also was not SIM unlocked like advertised. sad at the moment have been Waiting on a response from there support team as to how i should proceed.

Not compatible with verizon. Description says Unlocked for All Carriers is not accurate. Description also said New which is also inaccurate, should indicate refurbished. No Apple certification could be a counterfeit product.

This iPhone sold as a Fully Unlocked Renewed Premium device arrived "PENDING UNLOCK". This iPhone SE 2nd Gen was sold and fulfilled by Amazon.com. The item name includes the labels "Fully Unlocked" and I purchased the "Renewed Premium" quality. The device exceeded my expectations when it arrived. It looked perfectly new and the battery charged to a high percentage. The reason for the 1 star review is that it is 100% useless to me since its unlock status is "PENDING UNLOCK." Of course, I only discovered this after setting up new service on it and spending many hours on the phone with the new carrier troubleshooting the issue and traveling into a physical store to troubleshoot some more in person... only to find out the device is not as it was sold and is not unlocked. Buyer beware!

These are sprint phones.. Phone is fine. But it’s a sprint phone. Unlocked doesn’t mean unlocked for any carrier. Buyer beware. Now I have to return it becuase I don’t want 2 cell phone companies to deal with and it doesn’t work right on Verizon.

Check unlocking. I hated that two years after I bought this supposedly "fully unlocked" phone that it ended up locked to T Mobile. I used a mint Mobile card happily in it, but now I can't switch to Verizon. If you buy this, check that under Setting/General/About/Carrier Lock it says "No SIM Restrictions" instead of "SIM locked". If it ends up SIM locked, then you need to get the original seller to unlock it, and the runaround I'm getting between Mint, Amazon, Apple, T-Mobile and the Amazon reseller is that I'm S.O.L. I've heard so many different, conflicting BS explanations for why it happened and why it will be fixed in 24-72 hours (it never has in several) I don't believe any of them.

Not Completely unlocked as described. While description claimed it would work with all carriers, this phone was NOT compatible with AT&T, where we had planned on using it. Battery went down very fast for not even using the phone.
Wasn’t unlocked according to carrier.. I was skeptical then I was right.

The carrier blocked this iphone not even 3 hours after activation.. Just to make a long story short. The company seems nice as a whole. I am not sure if they know if the phones are reported lost/stolen or not. But Richard is the person you want to speak with if you have any issues. Very genuine guy and he processed my refund quickly. At&t would not honor the phone though. They said the IEMI number had been reported stolen. It was a headache. But at the end of the day I got my money back. I have no complaints. And we can all just move on.

It says unlocked on the packaging and in the system itself however as you see by the picture it is still attached to an Apple phone plan- I transfer all my information from my old phone to it and I could use the Wi-Fi but the carrier network would not let me use my carrier because it was still attached to Apple so it’s ‘not unlocked’ when it was promised to be “unlocked” as advertised. I need a phone that’s not on the network that’s unlocked completely so that I can add my SIM that works! I’ve been doing this the same way for years it shouldn’t have caused a problem. Thanks for the return and I will be buying another one soon as I’m refunded- hopefully this time you’ll get it right. Cheers!
Phone was LOCKED but sold as UNLOCKED. Could not use phone with my carrier because the phone was locked. Website said UNLOCKED phone.
Returned. Could not be activated. Verizon reported phone .... Returned. Could not be activated. Verizon reported phone was "lost or stolen", and service permanently suspended.

Can’t be activated. I have Sprint/T-mobile and have tried both (locked out to T-Mobile and Sprint) refurbished phones from this company. Neither of which could be activated due to IMEI numbers sent error codes, not allowing the carrier to connect the phones. Done with this BS! Save your time and go elsewhere!

Phone Not Unlocked!. Item title says phone is unlocked, the item was not unlocked, there was a Carrier SIM lock on it and I could not use my SIM card. They told me my best bet was to return the phone for another one, but they took $46 out as a restocking fee, and didn't give me a full refund, even though it was their mistake that I did not receive an unlocked phone. Will not be re-purchasing.

Was NOT unlocked. Seller is BuySPRY. Phone was listed as unlocked, but was in fact carrier locked. Seller and Amazon both failed to check the veracity of the listing. Hours wasted troubleshooting. This is the second such phone I’ve bought and had to return from Amazon. Beware of the untrustworthiness of such listings and the resultant hassle. We needed a phone that worked immediately, and were let down.

DID NOT COME UNLOCKED. Went through the whole set up process, installed new iOS, put on screen protector, and when switching SIM card over into this phone, the phone says it’s unable to work with this sim. Brought it to T-Mobile who said the phone is locked.

Great Phone, Make Sure It’s Compatible With Your Carrier. It was a great phone. It was packaged nicely and delivered in a decent amount of time. The quality of the product was great overall. The only issue I had was that it wasn’t compatible with my carrier. I had to do a return and they gave me a full refund with no issues. I would definitely recommend this phone to anyone who is able to use it with their carrier.
